name: Multi-Platform Social Media Publisher - API-Free Demo

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { contentId: 'POST-001', scheduledAt: new Date().toISOString(), title: 'Free SEO Audit', baseCaption: 'Want to know what is holding your website back? Get a free SEO audit today.', mediaUrl: 'https://example.com/media/seo-audit.jpg', callToAction: 'Send me a message to get started.', hashtags: ['SEO', 'DigitalMarketing', 'SmallBusiness'], platforms: ['Instagram', 'Facebook', 'LinkedIn', 'TikTok'], approvalStatus: 'Approved' } }];

return items.map(item => { const d = item.json; const errors = []; if (!d.contentId) errors.push('Missing content ID'); if (!d.baseCaption?.trim()) errors.push('Missing caption'); if (!d.mediaUrl?.trim()) errors.push('Missing media URL'); if (!Array.isArray(d.platforms) || d.platforms.length === 0) errors.push('No platforms selected'); if (d.approvalStatus !== 'Approved') errors.push('Content is not approved'); return { json: { ...d, isValid: errors.length === 0, validationErrors: errors } }; });

return items.map(item => { const d = item.json; const caption = `${d.baseCaption}\n\n${d.callToAction}`; return { json: { platform: 'Facebook', status: 'Published (Demo)', postId: `DEMO-FB-${d.contentId}`, publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), caption, mediaUrl: d.mediaUrl } }; });

return items.map(item => { const d = item.json; const caption = `${d.baseCaption} ${d.hashtags.slice(0, 4).map(h => `#${h}`).join(' ')}`.slice(0, 2200); return { json: { platform: 'TikTok', status: 'Published (Demo)', postId: `DEMO-TT-${d.contentId}`, publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), caption, mediaUrl: d.mediaUrl } }; });

const results = items.map(i => i.json); const successful = results.filter(r => r.status === 'Published (Demo)').length; return [{ json: { demoNotice: 'API-free simulation — no live posts were created.', executionStatus: successful === results.length ? 'SUCCESS' : 'PARTIAL', platformsProcessed: results.length, successful, failed: results.length - successful, completedAt: new Date().toISOString(), results } }];

return items.map(item => ({ json: { executionStatus: 'BLOCKED', demoNotice: 'Validation prevented publishing.', contentId: item.json.contentId || 'Unknown', errors: item.json.validationErrors, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }));
